summary: The note describes the Salzkammergut and Upper Austria Alps, a proposed name for a mountain subdivision of the Alps in Austria under a new classification of the range. Its German name is "Oberösterreichisch-Salzkammergut Alpen". The note is very brief and gives no further details such as elevations or boundaries.
one_line: Proposed name for a mountain subdivision of the Austrian Alps in a new Alpine classification.
key_facts: The Salzkammergut and Upper Austria Alps is the proposed name for a subdivision of mountains in a new classification of the Alps.
The subdivision is located in Austria.
The German name of the Salzkammergut and Upper Austria Alps is "Oberösterreichisch-Salzkammergut Alpen".
